source.review: original-resolution pixel audit with ten non-overlapping farm production crops

zones.title: Northern fields and orchard
zones.description: Inspect the corn, grain, pumpkins, market beds, orchard trees, paths, and field boundaries.

zones.title: Dairy barn and northern greenhouse
zones.description: Inspect the open dairy barn, cattle stalls, hay storage, milk equipment, silo, and greenhouse roof.

zones.title: Western beds, machinery, and apiary
zones.translation: 西侧种植床、农机与蜂场
zones.description: Inspect the trellised beds, crop rows, seed drill, cultivators, beehives, flower strip, and produce shed.

zones.title: Central tractor and working yard
zones.description: Inspect the tractor, trailers, wheelbarrow, hand tools, irrigation equipment, pallets, and nursery workbench.

zones.title: Eastern livestock and poultry pens
zones.description: Inspect the greenhouse edge, livestock paddock, sheep, goats, poultry run, coop, feeders, and fences.

zones.title: Farm pond and pollinator garden
zones.description: Inspect the pond, stone edge, aquatic plants, duck, jetty, footbridge, flowers, and fruiting tree.

zones.title: Nursery and propagation benches
zones.description: Inspect the propagation benches, seedling trays, pots, soil bags, small greenhouse, pails, hose, and path.

zones.title: Compost and soil handling yard
zones.description: Inspect the compost bins, organic piles, wooden box, cart, pitchfork, tumbler, wheel, and stone wall.

zones.title: Produce washing and packing equipment
zones.translation: 农产品清洗与包装设备
zones.description: Inspect the stainless wash equipment, hoses, vessels, support frames, controls, stairs, cartons, and bin.

zones.title: Produce storage and sorting bay
zones.description: Inspect the storage racks, vegetable crates, barrels, sorting table, sink, masonry bay, and garden edge.

removedAmbiguous.reason: the grain heads are visible but cultivar and related cereal species cannot be established from the pixels
the row is identifiable as pale bulb produce but onion, garlic, and another root crop are not reliably separable
the red crop is clear as produce but beet, chard, and lettuce identity is not decisive
fruit colors and tree forms are visible but exact apple and citrus cultivars are not encoded reliably
plants seen through glass are too occluded to assign species without guessing
coat colors are clear while breed-level identification is unsupported by the rendered anatomy
individual animals are clear but breed and sex traits are not resolved consistently
multiple valves, clusters, and canisters overlap and cannot all be traced as independent equipment
the red frame and shanks are visible but plow, subsoiler, and cultivator function overlap
the red machine is clear as an implement but mower, tiller, and seeder details conflict
small produce and container shapes on shelves merge at source resolution
several small metal shapes among the hand tools do not preserve distinct handles and jaws
the blue cylinders are visible but their hydraulic, filtration, or storage role cannot be proven
coat colors and goat silhouettes are clear but breed and sex classification would be speculative
several birds are present but only the most visually distinct rooster is safe to sex

removedAmbiguous.candidate: small bird species in the pond pen
removedAmbiguous.reason: tiny white and brown waterfowl silhouettes overlap fence lines and cannot all be classified
small marks in the water could be animals, reflections, or generated texture
pale marks among the lily pads do not resolve as independent blossoms
the propagation trays show healthy seedlings but leaf detail is insufficient for species labels
thin marks inside trays could be plant labels or support artifacts and are below reliable pointing size
organic piles have different colors and textures but process stage cannot be inferred from appearance alone
the vessels and hoses are visible but their exact industrial sequence and product flow are not shown
the green produce is clear but pepper, cucumber, and another vegetable shape are visually blended
partially occluded cans and boxes at panel edges do not retain complete independent silhouettes
the rendered cereal stand does not distinguish wheat from barley, so the retained label is grain field
the rendered cereal head does not distinguish wheat from barley, so the retained label is grain head
the compact poultry silhouette lacks a clearly resolved goose neck and body profile
the vague label duplicated green vegetable crate at the exact same target point
